notes.title: 6th Birthday! Particles, Multi-Grinding and Drinking Tea
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="iBo6lKYXVIc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Clomper has turned 6 years old! But I'm in no danger of slowing down development. Open Beta before the end of the year and I'm writing this on the last day of August![/p][p]I'm strictly working through the bare minimum of tasks before I start a broader test with people from the discord (called a closed Beta). It's "closed" because I will limit the numbers of people playing to keep collating feedback easier.[/p][p][/p][h2]Polish[/h2][p]Sparks now light up the new pipe and when you let your finger off the mouse, there's a burst of sparks too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/90cb8ff6740ac2d84b58139d1b581cf436ebd246.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now grind more than one piece of scrap at a time, which is perfect if you have lots of broken pipes or have collected a bit too much scrap![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/0799f1f0e001c46614ee9bd07ba426fd58e22416.png"][/img][/p][p]To reward yourself with a quest well completed and minimal damage, you can now brew and drink a delicious cup of tea (not safe for humans).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/e8d4bf8f16c3fa3f3d9770e8349b0b003ceeeb96.png"][/img][/p][h2]Closed Beta Next[/h2][p]I'll be running a closed Beta using Steam Playtest. If you would like to join in and find bugs before it goes onto open Beta, then keep a look out for a news story announcement.[/p][p]I'm exceptionally excited that you'll all get a chance to play soon![/p][p]Rob[/p]

notes.title: Alpha testing - more like destruction testing!
notes.notes:
[p]I had a great test run recently with my son, who is incisive and honest (and a bit brutal but that's ok). I'm pleased to say that most of the game held together well.[/p][h2]Fun Bugs[/h2][p]To give you a flavour of the bugs (now fixed), one was that the player's name (which should have been "Bean", not "dddddddwds sw ssssssssss") kept editing even though they had closed the options.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/00d5da9b880ffd453e89ccdc142321592d00aebb.png"][/img][/p][p]Another was that if you piled lots of items into the Grinder, then they would stretch weirdly through the floor.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/d78ed01e90b64de97f8045468b4e83ff9cb46d95.png"][/img][/p][h2]Reworked Steam Algorithm[/h2][p]The steam algorithm is the bit of code that decides how much power each machine gets once you have linked them up to a boiler. The old algorithm had some weird problems, which I discovered while streaming some game development. [/p][p]The new algorithm is much more predictable - and simpler to boot! A bit of behind-the-scenes for you - I tend to do a lot of the algorithm thinking on paper before I move to code.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/fc320f05759db48568327a400126c28d8e1f707a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Animations for Drinking Tea[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/ad7042c194e68179d14657e71fd4f991ec506bec.png"][/img][/p][p]Making a nice cup of tea has struck a chord with many, however there aren't any animations or visual effects for it just yet. I'm working on those now! Here's a peek at the up-and-coming models.[/p][p][/p][h2]Catch me on Twitch![/h2][p]Now that my life is in more of a regular rhythm, I am able to stream development of Clomper on Twitch. You're welcome to come and ask questions, give feedback or lurk and watch a man's sanity slowly unravel.[/p][p][url="https://www.twitch.tv/roblangdev"]See Clomper developed on Twitch![/url][/p][p]
Take care out there,[/p][p][/p][p]Rob[/p]

notes.title: Me: “This Is Silly.” Community: “DO IT!”
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9jJELkG-Qeg;full][/previewyoutube]

The big list of tasks has run dry and I cannot avoid alpha testing anymore! 

Alpha testing is where I ask people I'm close with to test out the game. Some will have played before, others will be new to it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/183be750d8b38d999f9e145984685b1fc61f2e07.png[/img]

Once I've fixed bugs and polished up from the feedback, it'll be time to run an invite only beta test for those in Discord. Some bug fixing and after that - GAME DEMO! Very exciting. If you're not able to join in on the Beta, that's OK - the demo will follow soon after and that demo will evolve toward a 1.0 release. Think of it as free early access.

[h2]Making Tea?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/bf49b5baab7f741a2348415509d960b8d90f671a.png[/img]

They say that a game is never finished, you just stop adding to it. I believe that a game without tea brewing isn't finished until you add making tea to it. The most requested feature (and even raised as a bug) was that you couldn't make tea. Now you need to feed the tea boiler with a huge amount of steam to make tea. It has no other game function but for the joy of making tea.

[h2]Steam now pushes everything[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/95bd4c65b23470bb547a19f2edd469565d0dcac4.png[/img]

Steam jetting quickly out of the end of a pipe always pushed the player but now it pushes anything that's loose! Scrap, broken pipes and even poor little fire sprites - they all get pushed across the Clomper! The more steam there is, the faster they go!

[h2]More FPS![/h2]

The pre-demo performance pass is done! I spent a lot of time analysing the lag spikes and fixing the worst offenders. I'll need to test on some older computers (I have an older laptop to test on) but I think a steady 60fps is possible.

2025 is definitely the year of the demo!

Rob

notes.title: Throwing pipes, dragging pipes, fog and light!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=aIooB4SV7AA;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm making great progress toward a demo coming to Steam in 2025!

I've been concentrating on feedback from my son, who has been playing Clomper on and off for years and gives me no-nonsense honest criticism. I'm eternally grateful for that.

[h2]Dead pipes are now scrap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/51deaa319c3b6575a99753ea92846672f5d433c7.png[/img]

When you bump into things, pipes break and now you must grind them like scrap to get their value back. You can throw them across the Clomper into the grinder, which is great fun - especially if you still have a partial pipe network built.

[h2]Lighting improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/209aa695de0da01cdb2f0af43fb14c1189af03ab.png[/img]

There's now moody fog in the Clomper and when the boilers get hot, the lighting changes to warn you. With some practice, you can drive the Clomper around with the boilers running hot but it's a balancing act - get it wrong and they go bang!

[h2]Inventory drag and drop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/7fdd209590a22b42a9d8d6d4102c41816f8f9725.png[/img]

You can now drag and drop pipes onto the tool and use hotkeys to assign. A small change but a welcome one. Controller support will come after the demo is out.

[h2]Coming next[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/9558301009478016cf4f230217714d7cdf3f89b7.png[/img]

You'll be able to brew a lovely cup of tea but piping steam into the seating area in the head. Doesn't serve any purpose but for the fun of it.

Check out the YouTube video for more sillyness.

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

notes.title: Multiplayer via Steam, Custom Game Rules and 5 years of development
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LemC0Fe9Qk0;full][/previewyoutube]

My goal is a demo that you can all play for free and to get there I've been polishing and implementing playtest feedback. The latest devlog includes an overview of 5 years of game development but let's concentrate on what's new.

[h2]Game Rules[/h2]

I have no idea how hard Clomper is to play. It's impossible for me to balance so I have added game rules as sliders so you can set up the game how you want to play. Set all the slides to one side and you get a creative mode. Push to the other and even moving the Clomper becomes tricky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/77dc01a65973354b58b1837ef8ecc4bd10b95150.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer via Steam[/h2]

You can now use the Steam front end to join your friends! Just click on their name and hit join. Clomper also now has a save/load system too. You would think that was obvious to put in but it's not had one until now!

[h2]Distance to Quest[/h2]

Amongst a bunch of player feedback (from my son!), I've added a cute marker that shows you how far you are from your quest objective. This is especially handy if the quest is off the edge of the map. When you get really close, the quest tube now flashes to tell you that it's under the Clomper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/a546e32cae80fabbf4eee726640f43258960cbb7.png[/img]

I've added numbers to the compasses, put the periscope direction on the main compass, simplified the claw controls and added mouse control to the periscope! Nothing frivolous here, all good things needed to get to the demo.

Have a great 2025!

[i]Rob[/i]

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

notes.title: Bringing the heat with visual effects!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=kVn-F59eiPg;full][/previewyoutube]

You would expect steam machines to spark and throw up clouds of steam when they work. I would too! And now they do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/231bfde1c1bfb492d8c615fa315284ea2162afe2.png[/img]

The inside of the Clomper keeps getting more beautiful (if you find steam beautiful, that is) and I have added more visual cues for when you are running the boilers hot or at high pressure. Run them too long and they will explode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/d5bfcab218c41b5531f4f1c26f88fd696b707a32.png[/img]

And if you crash, sparks will fly and smoke will billow out of broken machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/159d119a0f2259253501a13a8341302e122fbcb8.png[/img]

I'm still on plan for alpha testing with friends, beta testing with the Discord community and then a free demo. The demo will include pretty much all the functionality that is there now.

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

notes.title: Fire Sprite petting and Damage Animations
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=nF1NDSzrssc;full][/previewyoutube]

The theme for this update is when things aren't going so well! When you collide with the world, you damage the Clomper. Until now, the machines in the Clomper didn't show that they were damaged but now have animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/4f6ca60dd32900a40a554d257d2acbaaaabe7b67.jpg[/img]

I've also finished polishing the boiler movement (they shake when hot!) and improved the fire sprites. You can now pet them. Adorable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/30bceed18dc49853d78e951acff47177cafaf7d0.gif[/img]

It's amazing how much different the inside of the Clomper feels with many small changes. 

Check out the video for the full details, see you in the next update!

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: Pouring love into graphics: the map and periscope
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=YfIAM6RsRbY;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

I've been improving the graphics across Clomper, pouring love into the lighting and adding animations. The map and periscope together are how you navigate the Clomper. 

The map is strategic and for general clomping about, the periscope is for close up work. Until now, the graphics were simply there to test the game features but didn't feal alive.

[h2]Map[/h2]
The map now sinks down into its plinth with an iris closing over the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/96ce121b3ac6fd21a05eb4e101c07ca333566dcc.gif[/img]

[h2]Periscope[/h2]
The periscope, when switched off, is pushed telescopically into the floor and is eaten by the cowel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/0e612882825459ec6d6362cc3b5a23a359e82d6e.gif[/img]

[h2]Sumptuous boiler handles[/h2]
Deliciously round handles. I've never described them like food but now I have, I want to eat some. The animations are simplistic, juicy movement coming next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/9d11103627124db0039e727f4199337be0652670.png[/img]

[h2]About me![/h2]
This is a hobby project, I have a 9-5 in enterprise healthcare software and 2 kids along with all the other life stuff. I'm chipping away and happy with my progress. Sadly, I had some migraines at the start of April, so that meant everything took a backseat while I recovered.

[h2]Coming next[/h2]
More animations! When machines break, the only one that has an animation is a boiler. All the other machines need one. After that, more particle effects and some nice fog inside the Clomper.

The support and feedback has continued to be superb, thank you all.

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: Breathing life into a steampunk ladybird
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yI16nLU7ngQ;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

Until now, the floor was just to keep you from falling out the bottom of the Clomper. But now there's life! 

I've added 4 new machines, an actual floor and a charming little seating area. They all move in pace with the amount of boiler output you have set, you can see them spin up in the devlog video.

Let's get up close and personal with the machines...

[h2]The Masher[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/65391f59cf52dbc4c225fdd8655f046c0d14b4a4.png[/img]
When you feel the bits of scrap you find in the world, it turns it into teeny-weeny bits of scrap that you spend on new metal.

[h2]The Guv'nor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/a2bcdec2ec6b98c9cc473e86eab78efbdc2bab0b.png[/img]
A steam governor is a real thing! It uses mechnical feedback to regulate the steam supply.

[h2]The Gyro[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/eb749c784c579554cddf2eb4c54b0a8d76601a67.png[/img]
No matter what's happening in the Clomper, the Gyro always points north. Handy if everything else is broken and you don't know which way is up!

[h2]The Steam Reservoir[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/7eb3e0eee85d76c89212a177a15edfdd63b9791d.png[/img]
Beautiful and fantastical, the only purpose it serves is to glow blue when the steam levels are small and BRIGHT RED when you're at danger levels.

[h2]The Floor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/65e8f04a4e2e57f70ca1356a70bf1637149b28f4.png[/img]
On top of all those machines is the new floor. An organic, unplanned growth of this and that, protecting you from getting anything sensitive trapped in the machines.

[h2]Coming Next[/h2]
I'm going to experiment with the lighting and add more animations.

Thank you all for the feedback, support and thumbs up! It makes all the different.

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: Making the Clomper feel alive!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=woLgWVZPMk4;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

Although home life has become rather tiring, I've managed to beaver away at updating Clomper's graphics. I've really been enjoying it as the graphics have remained largely unchanged while I worked on game systems and netcode.

[h2]Progress![/h2]
My goal is a Steam demo and as you can see by the big yellow arrow, I'm getting really close. From left to right: I gave the Clomper legs, set up the Steam page, did a multiplayer test, put in better controls, added menus, created the inventory and updated the claw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/befb168873a0b4259ded0d941622b339291168a1.png[/img]

Left to do is: finishing off the graphics (that's going to take a while), alpha testing (with friends), beta testing (with the Discord peeps) and then Steam demo!

[h2]Adding life to the floor[/h2]
The Clomper is a living machine. If you've spent any time around steam locomotives then you'll know that the heat, sound, smell, steam and heft of them give them a feeling that they are alive somehow. Thousands of moving parts, dripping, seeping and sparking! I want to reproduce that in Clomper.

It's going to take a while to complete but I thought you might like to see my progress!

Here's a planetary gear system that will turn depending on how much steam you are using.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/e4a57674d74cfb7f5d64c45a0dd29eca7e0e54f1.gif[/img]

Pistons pump steam under the boilers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/202ac64199d718618f8d2dd012f5cabb2dcbaf23.gif[/img]

The lift has a new iris! I loved making this because I have a soft spot of irises. They are extremely satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/6d88a39d96d1f3b38a169c854924830ef4ac4ea9.gif[/img]

[h2]Coming Next[/h2]
Completing the floor of the Clomper, improving particles and bug fixing! Best place to see progress and discussion is on [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]Discord[/url]

The support and feedback has continued to be superb, thank you all.

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: New Claw and Economy Balance
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fPwZYWbYmGo;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

Two big things in this devlog and I'm quite excited by both of them for different reasons. Which one to do first? Alright, the economy.

[h2]Economic Balance[/h2]

Game economies can be hard to balance. Make the pipes more expensive then scrap you pick up more valuable then more expensive pipes and so on until you've escalated and everything costs millions!

I started with some numbers, wrote a surprisingly small amount of simple code in Jupyter Lab (in Python) and tweaked numbers to make sure that new games give you enough resources to collect more resources and that it doesn't take hours to make a really cool network.

[h2]New Claw[/h2]

The new claw is controlled with two wheels that you turn to make it move. It works much better than the differential steam method I had before. It's so much easier to use! Still takes a little skill but without any guesswork.

I've made the claw a ring and stuck the camera to the Clomper. I've been holding myself back from doing too much work on the graphics because that's coming next.

There's also a little flag that pops up when the claw has something ready to grab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/d4004b40de9e0ce6ca210ddbc276a27d671899a9.png[/img]

[h2]Coming Next![/h2]
Once I've finished testing and *cough* bug fixing *cough* I'll be working on a graphics refresh, so the next few devlogs will focus on that! It might become slightly odd looking for a while.

Life outside of game dev has been rather complex and tiring but I have enjoyed sinking myself back into the cosy confines of the Clomper for some clomping about.

Thank you for all your support, the feedback I get in the comments is heartwarming.

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: How do you tame a huge inventory?
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=SpHcqGpx3_k;full][/previewyoutube]
➡️ If you want to get more involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

Clomper currently has the bare minimum number of pipes: 5. You [i]can[/i] play with 2 different pipes (the unit and the bend) but... it's quite a challenge! Much more fun to put a few valves and switches in to make your life easier.

I will gradually be adding between [b]100-200[/b] pipes, at which point finding that perfect pipe to fit your network might be quite hard. Paging through loads of pipes is boring, so it's better to jump to the one you want.

How do you describe which one you want? The number of holes it has? How big it is? Whether it has something fancy like a valve or switch? That's what filters are for. Select the filters and it shows you the pipes that match.

The filters run down the left side: number of ports, size, interactivity, cost and then a nice reset button at the bottom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/840af3e22ad776bca029e75c22d1ec14b9ada05c.png[/img]

I also slammed on a scrap counter on the top right to show how much you have too.

There's a little left to do on the inventory (including game balancing all those numbers!) and I'll be moving onto improving and simplifying the claw.

[h2]Parking Weather for now[/h2]
I'd love to put weather in but I'm having to be ruthless and postpone it until after the demo. It will be great fun but not 100% necessary, so it can wait.

Life's been hard but I've still managed to chip away at progress! Finding a quiet house to make the video was hard, though.

Thanks to all your support, it keeps me going after a long day at my day job and having been used as a climbing frame by my children!

[i]Rob[/i]

notes.title: Introducing the Inventory
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=scj61pCMpMk;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ If you want to get involved then [url=https://discord.gg/53VMC9veCs]CHECK OUT THE DISCORD![/url]

[h2]The Inventory[/h2]

Clomper now [i]supports[/i] hundreds of pipes thanks to the new inventory! The old hotbar has gone, replaced with a 3D tool that you can fill with the pipes you like to use the most. Once on the Tool, you can then use them to build your fiendishly complex or elegantly simply pipe networks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048914/bc795fb1065eff03227a5c82dac1f4c97703cea7.png[/img]
I much prefer diegetic interfaces, which means that the information you need is in the game world. The old hotbar looked stuck on and while there are still areas that need to be made into physical models in the game, this is a big leap forward.

[h2]Next up: Paging, Filtering and Ordering[/h2]

As my full time job is as a lead web developer, the inventory has definitely felt like home and I am looking forward to adding paging, filtering and ordering to the pipes so that you can find the pipe you're looking for more easily. Right now there's only 5 but when there are [i]many[/i] pipes, I think filtering, ordering and paging will be very important.

[h2]Fan Art[/h2]

Another milestone has been receiving lovely unsolicited fan art from the Discord community. The works left me somewhat breathless - it feels like I'm doing something right when fan art is spot on. Thank you Sadcherries and Abberant Curse.

See you on the Discord!

[i]Rob[/i]
